Name: DE-Expenses
Statement:
select  eim.Oid as ExpenseId,
        eim.Number as ExpenseNumber,
        eim.Billable,
        eim.Motive,
        eit.Oid as ExpenseTypeId,
        eit.Name as ExpenseType,
        com.Name as Company,
        com.Id as CompanyId,
        vat.Oid as VatId,
        vat.Name as Vat,
        vat.Percentage as VatPercentage,
        eim.ValueWithVat,
        eim.VatValue,
        eim.ValueWithoutVat,
        eim.CreatedOnUtc,
        eim.ModifiedOnUtc,
        cre.Name as CreatedByName,
        mod.Name as ModifiedByName,
        cre.Id as CreatedById,
        mod.Id as ModifiedById
from    ExpenseItem eim
            left join Expense exp on exp.Oid = eim.Expense
            join ExpenseItemType eit on eit.Oid = eim.Type
            join CompanyLookup com on com.Id = eim.Company 
            left join Vat vat on eim.Vat = vat.Oid
            left join UserLookup cre on cre.Id = eim.CreatedBy 
            left join UserLookup mod on mod.Id = eim.ModifiedBy
